summary: Ran backend pytest regression and frontend desktop/mobile integration checks on public URL for latest open-world/no-RPG requirements. Core map/building/places/territory/gating/auth flows mostly pass; found one critical camera-position persistence regression in frontend startup logic.

ui_bugs.issue: Saved camera positions in low-coordinate regions are forcibly reset to capital on reload. App.js calls /players/home when x<10000 && y<10000, overwriting valid saved positions.

integration_issues.issue: After POST /api/players/position {x:5000,y:5000}, reloading UI resets to 32768,32808 and backend /players/me is overwritten to spawn due frontend initialize guard.

action_items: Remove/replace the App.js startup condition that auto-calls /players/home for x<10000 && y<10000; respect persisted camera coordinates across full world bounds.
Retest position persistence after fix using a low-coordinate valid map location (e.g., 5000,5000).
Optional: improve deterministic mobile building tap test docs/anchors (interaction works, but exact sampled tap points vary by viewport/camera).
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md when non-guest auth credentials become required.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/App.js line 28 mutates server state during startup for legitimate coordinates (x<10000 && y<10000), breaking persisted map-camera behavior.
Test credentials file is present but empty; acceptable for current guest-only testing, but add records when privileged flows are introduced.
seed_data_creation: Transient guest players/worlds/places created via tests; cleanup fixture removes test-created records by player_id/world_id/contracts at session teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 10 passed, 1 skipped (creatable token scarcity) on updated test suite aligned with no-RPG/name-only profile/open-world constraints. Frontend verified: no overflow on 1920x800 and 390x844, HQ click(960,230) works on desktop 1920x800, HQ enter/exit works desktop+mobile, places save/visit/remove works, settings persist, view-territory-on-map moves camera without membership gate. Critical unresolved regression: startup camera reset for low coordinates due App.js initialize condition.
rca of the issue: RCA: Frontend startup logic treats low coordinates as invalid and calls /players/home, which overwrites persisted position in backend and UI. Repro: (1) Save position via /api/players/position to x=5000,y=5000 with active token. (2) Reload page. (3) Coordinates show capital spawn and /api/players/me now returns spawn. Mitigation: remove heuristic threshold check and rely on backend validation/range checks only.
